nodes.text: Give an asymptotic formula for the number of $k\times n$ Latin rectangles .

#725 : [Er81] combinatorics Erdős and Kaplansky [ErKa46] proved the count is\[\sim e^{-\binom{k}{2}}(n!)^k\]when $k=o((\log n)^{3/2-\epsilon})$. Yamamoto [Ya51] extended this to $k\leq n^{1/3-o(1)}$. The count of such Latin rectangles is A001009 in the OEIS.
